title: Engestofte Gods Wedding Enquiry Flow Rubric
purpose: Determine whether each of the application's five wedding enquiry steps has enough clear information to continue. Classifications define completion requirements, not scores.

statuses.IN_PROGRESS: At least one required or relevant conditional item in the current step is missing or unclear. Ask one focused follow-up and remain on the same step.
statuses.STEP_COMPLETE: All required and relevant conditional items in the current step are sufficiently clear. Used only for steps 1 through 4.
statuses.DONE: Step 5 is complete. Optional items may remain unanswered.
statuses.OUT_OF_SCOPE: The customer clearly requests an event other than a wedding. Stop intake politely.

fields.completion_rule: A contact person's name is explicitly provided.

A desired date or date range is provided. For this school project, assume all 2028 dates are unbooked in the demo calendar. A 2028 date outside July may be described as free in the project calendar, but never as a confirmed booking. Weddings are typically not held in July; for a July date, explain this and ask whether the customer wants Engestofte to check for a rare exception or prefers another date. Never promise an exception. Availability in other years is unknown and must not be inferred.

steps.name: Guests and accommodation

fields.completion_rule: An expected guest count is provided.
Record whether accommodation is wanted when the customer provides this information. Its absence does not block step completion.
Collect the number of people needing accommodation, or clarify whether this is not decided yet.
Collect relevant nights or a date range, or clarify whether this is not decided yet.

Do not recommend the Intimpakke or offer a comparison based only on guest count. Contents, price, target group and value compared with the standard package are not confirmed. If the customer asks, say Engestofte can clarify whether a suitable package or quote is available. This field never blocks completion.
Offer at most once to investigate bus transport between a nearby hotel and Engestofte. Do not promise availability or booking.

steps.offer_order: Do not present the disabled Intimpakke offer. If the bus investigation is applicable, present it at most once and do not block step completion on it.

fields.completion_rule: Clarify whether the customer wants a ceremony, or record that this is not decided yet.
The form or location is stated, or the customer explicitly says it is not decided yet.
Ask when useful; if the customer does not know, this does not block completion.
Clarify whether dinner is part of the requested event, or record that this is not decided yet.

fields.condition: The customer wants a party after dinner
fields.completion_rule: Clarify when relevant; do not block on details the customer has not decided.

steps.name: Food, drink and other wishes

fields.completion_rule: Collect when offered; a decline or undecided answer is valid.
Ask or record when relevant; a decline or undecided answer is valid.
Collect if volunteered; never block completion for missing details, a decline, or undecided answer.

steps.completion_rule: Step 5 can finish without optional details. Optional information is never mandatory.

global_rules: Use information volunteered in any conversation turn to satisfy the relevant field, even if that field belongs to a later step; never ask the customer to repeat it.
Ask one focused follow-up at a time and do not repeat answered questions.

When values for the same field conflict, state the conflicting values neutrally and ask which is correct. Do not choose, overwrite, or discard either value. A critical conflict blocks completion until clarified; an optional conflict does not block completion.
Do not invent facts or confirm availability, prices, capacity, package details, transport, or bookings.

For this school project, 2028 is assumed unbooked in the demo calendar; this is not a claim about Engestofte's real calendar. The usual July wedding closure still applies and rare exceptions require Engestofte to assess them. Availability in other years is unknown.
The 2026 standard wedding package price list is historical and must not be presented as a current quote. Intimpakke contents and price are unconfirmed; do not recommend it or invent a comparison.
The application controls step advancement and presents the fixed localized introduction after STEP_COMPLETE.
